description: Address review findings from 2025-05-26-111000-review.md: strip spoofed X-Rate-Limited-By header in edge worker, add try/except around asyncio.gather in non-streaming chat path, optimize expire calls with asyncio.gather, and remove ineffective Connection: keep-alive header from Workers proxy.
steps: STEP 1 - In apps/edge/src/index.ts, after the CORS preflight early return, strip X-Rate-Limited-By header from client requests to prevent spoofing.
STEP 2 - In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, wrap the asyncio.gather call in the non-streaming _process_chat() function with try/except and set defaults for context_chunks and history.
STEP 3 - In apps/backend/app/api/deps/rate_limit.py, fire the two expire calls concurrently with asyncio.gather when both need to run. Add import asyncio at top if needed.
STEP 4 - In apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts, remove the Connection: keep-alive header line since it has no effect in Workers runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Edge worker strips X-Rate-Limited-By from incoming requests before any logic uses it
Non-streaming chat path handles asyncio.gather exceptions gracefully with defaults for context_chunks and history
Redis expire calls run concurrently when both are needed
No Connection: keep-alive on outbound proxy requests
Edge typecheck passes (pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build)
verification: APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long-for-ci python -m pytest tests/test_latency_audit.py tests/test_endpoints_audit.py tests/test_pipeline_audit.py tests/test_chat.py -v
findings: All 4 review fixes implemented and verified. Edge typecheck passes. 28/28 edge tests pass. 24/24 backend tests pass (test_latency_audit, test_endpoints_audit, test_pipeline_audit, test_chat). The test_chat.py file had a pre-existing issue from the FEAT-002 changes where check_rate_limit mock returned a 3-tuple instead of the updated 4-tuple - this was already fixed in the working tree before this feature.
